requirement: a class-C (yellow) call with no operator answer is approved after 100 s, while blacklist/whitelist rules and red denials are unchanged; subfolders of a listed parent folder are folded in recently-intercepted

assertions.timeout: DEFAULT_PENDING_TIMEOUT_MS = 100_000; on expiry the pending call resolves allow and records a session grant
assertions.lists_unchanged: red denies immediately (never queued); whitelist hits allow immediately (never queued)
assertions.next_call_blue: the auto-approved fingerprint is added to session grants, so the identical next call runs immediately
assertions.fold_parents: folder_in uses bidirectional containment: a child folder under a listed parent maps to that list and is collapsed
assertions.readonly_green: read-only tools are green (read/grep/glob/web_*/status/health/metrics/inspect, job_list/job_output/job_status/job_wait, w2m_status/devices/tasks/history/report/memory/stats); mutating tools (job_kill/job_start/w2m_run/w2m_cancel/w2m_intent) stay yellow
